headline: Tissot Le Locle or Oris Artelier?
stop_reason: No clean same-money pair passed every check on this run. Best candidate: Oris 01 733 7810 4051-07 6 20 17FC at USD 2,200 (oris.ch, checked 2026-11-24, available online) vs Tissot T932.408.41.033.00 at USD 2,225 (tissotwatches.com/en-us, checked 2026-11-24, reference confirmed on the official US page). Both prices share one date and are within 10%. It was stopped because the only Tissot photo in the library shows a blue leather-strap variant, while T932.408.41.033.00 is listed with a bracelet, so the cover photo would not match the watch. No rights-cleared bracelet photo was found. Other pairs failed: Oris 01 733 7762 4054 is out of stock on the official US site; the other library pairs have different check dates or prices more than 10% apart. Next step: find a bracelet photo for the Tissot T932.408.41.033.00 (official media page) or pick another pair.
